name: The Royal Holiday
source:
You've gotten married and saved Cordonia, but before you embark on your honeymoon, Olivia's invited you to spend the holidays in Lythikos! There'll be plenty of snow, mistletoe, and uniquely local traditions in The Royal Holiday as you and your friends help Cordonia's fiercest duchy rediscover the true meaning of Christmas.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Royal_Holiday]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你已经结婚，也拯救了科尔多尼亚。不过，在蜜月开始之前，奥莉维娅邀请你去利西科斯过节！在《The Royal Holiday》中，漫天白雪、槲寄生与独具特色的当地传统等着你。你将和朋友们一起，帮助科尔多尼亚最彪悍的公国重新发现圣诞节的真谛。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Royal_Holiday]Choices Wikia[/url]]
